figurative_meaning_en: To stand with one's head held high
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় সফল হয়ে সে সোজা হয়ে দাঁড়াল।
জয়ের পর তারা সবাই সোজা হয়ে দাঁড়িয়ে গান গাইল।
example_sentences_in_english: After succeeding in the exam, he stood with his head held high.
After the victory, they all stood tall and sang songs.
note: This idiom emphasizes personal dignity and is commonly used in contexts of achievement or resilience in Bengali culture.
